rs.innovation_approach: 把知识密集视觉问答分解为对象识别与事实检索：模型生成指代表达交给 GroundingDINO 裁图检索，再根据检索摘要迭代改写文本查询；用含直答/搜索的教师轨迹冷启动，再做结果 RL。
rs.key_step: 以问题相关实体的指代表达作为视觉搜索的中间接口，并在检索反馈后重新生成文本查询；SFT 保留 50:50 搜索/不搜索行为，检索文本仅作上下文、不作为预测监督。
rs.why_non_obvious: 整图检索会被背景实体干扰；固定两次检索对简单题反而有害。裁图后返回的是网页文本摘要，不是新增高分辨率像素，因此与 caption+crop 的信息通道不同。
rs.trigger_condition: When external visual identification and factual retrieval require different queries and feedback, delegate localization to a grounding tool and iteratively refine text queries to obtain relevant evidence.
reviewer_praise: 历史 review xV7smTral1 肯定裁图工具和多轮自我修正的设计及数据到训练的工作量。
历史 review u2ozAUwUnH 肯定数据集、表达和消融分析。
reviewer_concern: 历史 review xV7smTral1 质疑 GroundingDINO 定位和返回检索的验证缺失；mDYsDj6MS8 质疑噪声/空返回稳健性和奖励校准。
历史 review GcBHHqB4Wh 质疑 RL 较 SFT 仅增加 0.90 点却带来的成本，以及私有搜索 API 的复现性。
历史 review GcBHHqB4Wh 指出图像搜索只能一次、文本可多次的不对称限制，并要求明确 loss masking。

rs.abstract_strategy: Delegate localization and information retrieval to different tools, then train a controller on balanced tool-use demonstrations.
rs.abstract_key_step: Generate a target description, retrieve focused evidence, and revise subsequent queries from returned feedback.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Separate the artifact used to retrieve evidence from the evidence returned to the controller; preserve a no-tool behavior in the demonstration distribution.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When background information distracts retrieval and fixed calls add noise, condition queries on the task and learned feedback while retaining a direct-response option.

signatures.failure_boundary: No matched crop-vs-whole counterfactual necessity study or API-failure robustness test reported. Visual search cannot be retried, and lost outside-crop context can matter. Returned evidence is text, not direct crop pixels.

signatures.object: Online tool policy initialized from SFT
signatures.information: Policy-generated complete trajectories plus ground-truth final answer judged by an external model and output-format score. No per-crop correctness or per-turn usefulness supervision.
signatures.operation: Sample eight trajectories per prompt, center composite correctness/format reward by group mean, optimize clipped token probability ratios with KL and mask input/tool-return tokens.
signatures.output: Updated tool-selection and answer policy on FVQA, which is intentionally more image-search-heavy than SFT data.
signatures.claimed_effect: Table1 average56.23→57.13 (+0.90pp), DynVQA43.08→45.87, A-OKVQA76.94→73.45. Fig.4/§4.2 reports cropped image search −36.81%/−34.86% on DynVQA/OKVQA while image+mixed search increases. These are author-reported associations, not causal proof of necessity or noninferiority.

objective.signal_routing: SFT CE covers generated reason, tool tags/query and final answer; retrieved information is masked. RL broadcasts one trajectory advantage to generated-token ratios; input/tool-return tokens masked per App.D. No action-specific crop credit, token-category routing, necessity gate or explicit crop charge. Exact aggregation denominator/implementation mask not specified by E_i,t; do not infer PPO epochs, reuse or clipping activity.
objective.normalization_caveat: Printed A=R−Rbar, not standard-deviation-normalized. Treat as paper formula, not verified veRL configuration; actual code unavailable/uninspected.
objective.invariance: Analytic reading: subtracting group mean removes common reward offsets but not reward scale (the prose scale-independence claim is too broad). No potential shaping/invariance theorem. Nonzero format reward and KL alter objective; finite self-inclusive mean scales on-policy score expectation by (K−1)/K under standard independent-sample fixed-weight assumptions, not necessarily token-weighted implementation.
objective.baseline_or_potential: Self-inclusive empirical mean of same-prompt sampled total rewards; no critic or state-value potential. Frozen reference policy for KL; separate answer judge with unresolved GPT-5/GPT-4o identity.
objective.degenerate_cases: Analytic consequences, not measured: if all total rewards equal (all-correct/all-wrong with equal format score), centered advantage=0 while KL may still update. Format variation can make otherwise all-correct/all-wrong groups nonzero. K=1 gives zero centered advantage. A single-turn trajectory reduces to ordinary centered sequence-outcome RL. At p(action)≈0/1 natural sampling may lack alternatives; dataset balancing is not forced RL support and no guarantee is given.
